rows.contract: Frame owns pixel contents and actual native completion state.
rows.native_mapping: Move-only frame checkout owns exact sized/color/sample Metal allocation, resolve attachment and budget reservation. Producer explicitly retains it in actual encoding.
rows.expected_result: Compile owning ABI and verify checkout move, slot reuse and abandonment in 073.
rows.actual_result: Actual Apple arm64 ARC header compile, native resolve descriptor, 68 exact independent transfer selection cases and neutral include closure. PICA 48 cases / 801 assertions and CTest 64 passes plus 5 skips.

rows.contract: Constructor binds independent frontend, device, renderer scheduler and worker policy.
rows.native_mapping: Use existing EmuWindow and its generation, explicit device instance, actual source scheduler and bounded native pool. Native sync and async caller modes share one implementation.
rows.expected_result: Compile shared consumer, exercise primary and secondary windows plus both modes.
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: Wait for all queued frames and in-progress submits before reuse.

rows.contract: The renderer records asynchronous commands before handing the frame to Present. A Retain call on the original Frame inside the worker can race with moving the Frame into Present.
rows.native_mapping: Pin the exact allocation in a producer-side scheduler command before any consumer ownership transfer.
rows.expected_result: Compile the native caller and run deterministic host checks; add physical GPU ownership and pacing coverage in Phase 073.
rows.actual_result: Actual SDK compiler and available targeted fixture passed. Live pacing or frame retirement still requires Metal 4 hardware.
